title: setup with no or a wrong subcommand, a bad --scope or --harness, a stray word or an unknown flag are usage errors (exit 2) and write nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `jitso setup` names what is missing and prints the usage; `setup hooks` is an unknown subcommand; `--scope` without a value is `--scope needs a value`, any value but user or project is `--scope must be user or project`, and `--scope=user` is an unknown argument (the flag takes its value as the next word, as in `install skill`); a positional word or a flag the command does not declare is `unknown argument`. `--harness` without a value is `--harness needs a value`, and a list with an empty or unknown name is `--harness must be a comma list of claude, codex, opencode and pi, or all`. `.claude` is never created. (`--scope user` itself is a valid scope since v0.2: see `setup/hook/user-scope-*`.)

stderr.regex:
^jitso setup: missing what to set up \(hook[^)]*\)

Usage: jitso setup hook \[--scope project\|user\] \[--harness <list>\] \[--absolute\] \[--remove\] \[--force\] \[--dry-run\] \[--yes\]
^jitso setup: unknown subcommand "hooks"\n\nUsage: jitso setup hook

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: --scope must be user or project
JITSO REJECTED: --harness must be a comma list of claude, codex, opencode and pi, or all
JITSO REJECTED: --harness must be a comma list of claude, codex, opencode and pi, or all
